name: Supine Arms in Straps — Out & In
stable: Pelvis, spine and legs in tabletop
summary: Legs in tabletop, hands in the straps: arms open out to the sides and press back in to the hips.
steps: Lie on the back, legs in tabletop, hands in the short loops, arms long beside the hips.
Breathe in to open the arms out towards shoulder height.
Breathe out to press the palms back to the hips.

layers.title: Hold the arms out
layers.text: Hold wide and extend the legs.

layers.title: Scissors or leg splits
layers.text: Legs move while the arms work.

modifications: Feet down on the footbar if the back arches.

cautions.note: Lying flat on the back: keep it to a few minutes, raise the head end if you can, and stop if she feels dizzy.

cues:
Arms stop just below shoulder height.
Knees over hips; lower back quiet.
Soft elbows.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.
